stage_a.score: P(Original): logistic regression predict_proba[:, 1], averaged with the BiLSTM sigmoid output when the BiLSTM is available
stage_a.rule: flag as computer-generated if score < threshold

stage_b.score: softmax probability of output index 0 (machine-generated, MAGE convention) from the detector
stage_b.rule: flag as computer-generated if score >= threshold
stage_b.chosen_on: pooled validation human reviews (n=450): flag at most 1%

fusion: computer-generated if Stage A flags OR Stage B flags
